18.2.title: Ball Out of Bounds or Lost
18.2.canonical_source: USGA / R&A Official Rules of Golf 2026
18.2.summary: If a ball is out of bounds or lost outside a penalty area, the player must take stroke-and-distance relief by adding one penalty stroke and playing a ball from where the previous stroke was made.
key_subsections: 18.2a (When Ball is Lost or Out of Bounds)
18.2b (What to Do When Ball is Lost or Out of Bounds)

17.1.title: Options for Ball in Penalty Area
17.1.canonical_source: USGA / R&A Official Rules of Golf 2026
17.1.summary: Penalty areas are defined as yellow or red. Player may play ball as it lies without penalty, or take one penalty stroke for stroke-and-distance relief, back-on-the-line relief, or lateral relief (red penalty areas only).
key_subsections: 17.1e (Relief for Ball Not Found But in Penalty Area)

19.2.title: Relief Options for Unplayable Ball
19.2.canonical_source: USGA / R&A Official Rules of Golf 2026
19.2.summary: Player is the sole judge of whether ball is unplayable anywhere on course except penalty area. Three relief options for 1 penalty stroke: Stroke-and-distance, back-on-the-line, or lateral relief within two club-lengths.

14.3.title: Dropping Ball in Relief Area
14.3.canonical_source: USGA / R&A Official Rules of Golf 2026
14.3.summary: Player must drop the ball from knee height in straight down motion without touching player or equipment before hitting ground. Ball must land in and stay within designated relief area.
key_subsections: 14.3b (Ball Must Be Dropped in Right Way)
14.3c (Ball Dropped in Right Way Must Come to Rest in Relief Area)
